newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Northern Cyprus to open stock exchange in July.
newsitem.headline: Northern Cyprus to open stock exchange in July.

text.p: Erdal Onurhan, economy minister in the self-declared Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (TRNC) said they planned to open a stock exchange in July.
"Our target is to open the North Cyprus Stock Exchange in July," Onurhan told Reuters.
He said four statutes were being prepared to regulate the memberships of intermediaries, listings of companies and operational procedures of the bourse.
Onurhan said they would send the outline of the bourse legislation to a committee of the TRNC parliament on June 25 for approval.
